title: Connect pass payload
description: The payload of a connect pass, the exact JSON bytes the control plane signed. Its members come in no set order: the pass carries the exact bytes signed, and the adapter parses those bytes. A connect pass is the payload in base64url without padding, a dot, and the signature in base64url without padding, at most 1024 characters with no white space; the signature is 64 bytes of Ed25519 under the control plane's server key over qory-connect-ed25519-v1, a line feed and the payload bytes. The control plane sends a person to the adapter's connect_url (adapter.schema.json) with the pass as the query parameter state. The adapter sends the page that receives the pass with Referrer-Policy: no-referrer, so the pass leaves in no Referer header. The adapter decodes the pass strictly, both parts as strict base64url without padding, and verifies the signature under a server key the adapter pinned at enrolment: after a server key rotation it tries each pinned key, and any one that verifies passes. It then reads the payload against this schema, checks that adapter_id is the id the adapter is enrolled as, and refuses a pass whose expires_at has passed on its clock, or is more than 15 minutes ahead of it. It records the nonce in one atomic check-and-insert, refusing a nonce it has seen. It keeps the nonce, in storage that survives a restart, until expires_at has passed on its clock. connection_id names the connection the person is making; connection_id in definitions.schema.json says when it is made. After its checks, the adapter links the access the source grants to that connection_id. Access the source grants without a connect pass links nothing. The adapter links a grant only when the source confirms it for this flow. The person authorised the grant at the source during this flow, and the source returned it to the same flow that carries the pass. The adapter keeps the pass on its side, bound to the person's browser for example by a cookie it set when the flow began, and checks with the source, under the person's own authorisation there, that this person controls the grant. It never links a grant identified only by a value the browser sends back. A grant is linked to at most one live connection. A grant already linked to another live connection is refused until that connection ends (connections-disconnect.schema.json). So the race rule ends another connection's collection only when the source has really moved the collection between grants (source-collections.schema.json).

adapter_id.description: The adapter the pass is for, as the control plane enrolled it.

connection_id.description: The connection the person is making, as the control plane issued it. The adapter links the access the source grants to it, and names it in source-collections.schema.json.

nonce.description: 128 random bits in base64url without padding, 22 characters, new for each pass.

expires_at.description: When the pass expires, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds, at most 15 minutes after the control plane issued it. The adapter refuses a pass whose expires_at has passed on its clock, or is more than 15 minutes ahead of it, and keeps the pass's nonce until expires_at has passed.
